description: Get the current stock quote for a company including price, volume, change, market cap, and other real-time market data. Use this when a user asks about a stock's current price or trading activity. Always includes halted/haltCode/haltReason/haltedAt/resumptionAt trading-halt fields (false/null when trading normally); a halted ticker returns the last-known quote instead of an error, or currentPrice:null + halted:true when nothing is recoverable. marketCap is the live price × the SEC-derived share count; when that count is unavailable it is null with marketCapWithheldReason set — NOT MEASURED, never "no market cap" and never $0. The count itself rides as `sharesOutstanding` with `sharesOutstandingAsOf` + `sharesOutstandingAsOfKind` ("stated" = the issuer's statement date; "checked" = when it was last confirmed against a vendor; "none" = date not recorded) and a vendor-free `sharesOutstandingSource` — quote the date with the count. When no MEASURED count exists, `sharesOutstanding` and `marketCap` are a BEST ESTIMATE (the newest dated filed or reference count, moved onto today's split basis): `sharesOutstandingEstimated: true`, `sharesOutstandingEstimateKind` ("at_least" = the filings record later issuances of unstated size, so the true count is likely higher) and `marketCapEstimated: true`. Say it is an estimate and give its date.
name: get_quote
title: Get Stock Quote
